item.title: Formula 1 teams confirm full practice driver schedule for 2025 season | Formula 1
item.description: Nine Formula 1 drivers including championship contender Oscar Piastri will miss the first practice session for the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.

item.title: “Not acceptable” for McLaren to tell Piastri to help Norris win title now – Russell | Formula 1
item.description: McLaren should not resort to team orders in the final race of the season to ensure one of their drivers wins the world championship, says George Russell.

item.title: McLaren haven’t discussed team orders, says Norris: ‘I’d love it but I won’t ask for it’ | Formula 1
item.description: McLaren have not discussed the possibility of imposing team orders to ensure one of its drivers wins the world championship this weekend, according to Lando Norris.

item.title: “I’m decent at adapting”: Hadjar “confident” he’ll succeed alongside Verstappen | Formula 1
item.description: Isack Hadjar believes he can succeed where Max Verstappen's previous team mates failed because he of his ability to adapt to unfamiliar cars.

item.title: Canada was my most obvious missed opportunity to score more points – Norris | Formula 1
item.description: Lando Norris says his crash in the Canadian Grand Prix was the most obvious point in the season where he missed an opportunity to score more points.

item.title: Chance to win title is “not really in my control”, says Verstappen | Formula 1
item.description: Max Verstappen says the destiny of the world championship is out of his control as he bids to win the title for the fifth year in a row.

item.title: I was accused of something I would never do, says Antonelli after death threats | Formula 1
item.description: Andrea Kimi Antonelli says several Red Bull team members contacted him after the team acknowledged the false accusations he had faced.

item.title: Hamilton worried by Hadjar’s move to Red Bull: ‘I hope he gets the right support’ | Formula 1
item.description: Lewis Hamilton is concerned how Isack Hadjar will fare alongside Max Verstappen next year: "We all know what happens when people go to Red Bull."

item.title: Joining Red Bull when they were ‘having a war internally’ was difficult – Tsunoda | Formula 1
item.description: Yuki Tsunoda said his move to Red Bull was made more difficult by the circumstances in the team at the time, after learning he will not keep his seat for next season.

item.title: Round-up: Finale will be ‘nerve-wracking’ for Norris and Piastri says Verstappen, and more | RaceFans Round-up
item.description: Friday's edition of the RaceFans round-up.
